blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Realistic few-shot adaptation of medical vision-language models (VLMs) can leave low-prevalence classes without any labeled support. The training-free SS- Text+ solver remains operational in this setting, but its zero-support prototypes receive no visual adaptation and fall back to a purely textual class prototype. We in- troduce Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (GProtoT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation. In 50 paired realistic one-shot trials on MESSIDOR with FLAIR features, severe and proliferative diabetic retinopathy were absent from every support set. Relative to SS-Text+, gated ProtoT improved missing-class recall by 5.23 points, average class accuracy by 1.37 points, and the missing/supported recall harmonic mean by 1.83 points. It reduced negative- transfer frequency from 46-48% for ungated transfer to 2%, while at the cost of reductions of 1.20 percentage points in supported-class recall and 0.45 percentage points in top-1 accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-based gating provides a safety mechanism for the knowledge source. GProtoT is based on SS- Text+ and requires no gradients, validation data, or additional model inference, of- fering a low-compute path toward accountable adaptation under incomplete clini- cal supervision. Code is available: https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT
blocks.zh: 医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)的实实在在的几发改编可以留下低发率的班级,而没有任何标签支持. 免训练的SS-Text+解析器在此设置中仍然可以运行,但其零支持原型没有获得可视化改造,并回归纯文本类原型. 我们通过转录Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer(GProtoT),一个利用VLM相似性和基于肿瘤的临床距离将支持级视觉残基转移至缺失类的预推模块. 基于语义相关性和剩余协议的无验证证据门比例转移,从而限制了无支持的推断. 在对具有FLAIR特征的MESIDOR进行50个对齐的一发试验中,每组支助中都缺少严重和扩散性糖尿病复方疗法。 相对于SS-Text+,Gated ProtoT改进了缺失级召回5.23分,平均级精度为1.37分,缺失/支持的召回谐音平均值为1.83分. 它将负转移频率从负调值的46-48%降低到2%,同时将支持级召回的1.20个百分点和最高1的准确度降低0.45个百分点。 这些结果表明,基于证据的定位为知识来源提供了安全机制。 GProtoT基于SS-Text+,不需要梯度、验证数据或额外的模型推论,即-在不完全的clini-cal监督下,为可问责的适应设置低计算路径。 代码:https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical VLMs provide transferable representations and text-derived class prototypes, making black-box few-shot adaptation possible without updating a large encoder ( Shakeri and others, 2024 ) . Yet the conventional balanced K K -shot protocol is poorly aligned with disease prevalence. Common findings may appear repeatedly while rare or severe categories receive no labeled examples, and aggregate accuracy can then remain high even when clinically important categories are unrecognized.
blocks.zh: 医学VLM提供可转移的表示和文本衍生的类原型,使得黑盒几发改编成为可能而无需更新大型编码器(Shakeri等人,2024年). 然而,传统平衡的K K射击规程与疾病的流行程度不相符。 常见的发现可能反复出现,而稀有或严重类别则得不到任何标注的例子,因此即使临床上重要的类别得不到承认,总的准确度仍然很高。

blocks.en: Silva-Rodríguez and others (2025b) introduced SS-Text+, a closed-form text-based linear probe to formalize realistic, imbalanced, validation-free adaptation. For a class with no support, SS-Text+ correctly retains its text prototype rather than fitting an undefined visual evidence. This behavior is robust, but limited-supported classes become task-adapted while a missing class remains purely zero-shot. An alternate method is to borrow a related supported prototype. Our experiments show that borrowing a related supported prototype strategy is unsafe and, due to ungated VLM and ontology-guided transfer, reduced balanced performance and missing-class recall is nearly half of support trials.
blocks.zh: Silva-Rodríguez等人(2025年b)引入了SS-Text+,这是一种基于文本的封闭式线性探测器,用于将现实,不平衡,无验证的适应正式化. 对于一个没有支持的类,SS-Text+正确保留了它的文本原型,而不是安装一个未定义的视觉证据. 这种行为很强健,但有限的支持类在缺失类保持纯粹零镜头时,会成为任务适应类. 另一种方法是借用相关的支持原型. 我们的实验表明,借用一个相关的支持原型战略是不安全的,由于VLM和本体学指导的转移,平衡性能的降低和缺级召回几乎是支持试验的一半。

blocks.en: We therefore ask whether cross-class transfer can improve a zero-support prototype without turning external knowledge into a source of negative transfer? We propose evidence-based GProtoT, a training-free module applied after SS-Text+ forms class prototypes and before its standard repulsion step. The main formulation transfers visual residuals, preserving the missing class’s text semantics, and the evidence-based gate shrinks the update when semantic relevance or source agreement is weak. Our contributions are: • a non-recursive residual-transfer rule that employs only originally supported classes • a VLM, ontology, and hybrid neighbor construction with a validation-free evidence-based gate • a paired safety evaluation that reports missing-class recall, supported-class recall, their harmonic mean, and negative-transfer frequency, not only overall accuracy
blocks.zh: 因此,我们问,跨类转让能否改善零支持原型,而不把外部知识变成负面转让的来源? 我们提出基于证据的GProtoT,一个在SS-Text+形成班级原型后并在其标准反推步骤前应用的无训练模块. 主要配方转移视觉残基,保留缺失类的文本语义,在语义相关性或源协议薄弱时,基于证据的门缩小了更新. 我们的贡献是: 一种不重复的剩余转移规则,它只使用最初支持的类 —— 一个VLM、肿瘤学和混合式邻建,有一个无验证的基于证据的门 —— 一对安全评价,报告缺失级召回、支持级召回、其口号平均值和负转移频率,而不仅仅是总体准确性

blocks.en: a non-recursive residual-transfer rule that employs only originally supported classes
blocks.zh: 仅使用最初得到支持的类别的非重复剩余转让规则

blocks.en: a VLM, ontology, and hybrid neighbor construction with a validation-free evidence-based gate
blocks.zh: a VLM、肿瘤学和混合式邻建,并设有无验证的循证门

blocks.en: a paired safety evaluation that reports missing-class recall, supported-class recall, their harmonic mean, and negative-transfer frequency, not only overall accuracy

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We build upon the official SS-Text+ implementation and utilize its cached FLAIR representations for grading diabetic retinopathy in MESSIDOR ( Decencière and others, 2014 ; Silva-Rodríguez and others, 2025a ) . The classification includes five ordinal categories: no retinopathy, mild, moderate, severe, and proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Following the realistic K = 1 protocol, the total dataset for support consists of five images sampled according to the training prevalence. Across seeds 0–49, each support set contained counts of [ 3 , 1 , 1 , 0 , 0 ] [3,1,1,0,0] , while the identities of support images varied; severe and proliferative disease categories were consistently absent. Prevalence-weighted sampling at k = 1 k=1 yields the same class count pattern in every seed, so seed variance measures only sensitivity to support selection. Because the identity of the absent classes is not varied, missing-class results should be interpreted as specific to this particular zero-support configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们以正式的SS-Text+实施为基础,利用FLAIR的缓存表述,在MESIDOR(Decencière等人,2014年;Silva-Rodríguez等人,2025年a)中将糖尿病复发性复发性病分级。 分类包括5个正统类:无还原性,轻度,中度,重度和扩散性糖尿病还原性. 遵循现实 K = 1 协议,支持的总数据集由5个图像组成,根据训练普及程度进行抽样. 在0-49号种子中,每套支持包含[3、1、1、0、0]个计数[3、1、1、0],而支持图像的特性则各不相同;严重和扩散性疾病类别始终不存在。 普遍加权采样在k=1k=1时,在每个种子中产生相同的等级计数模式,因此种子差异只测量支持选择的敏感性. 由于缺课类的特征没有变化,缺课类结果应解释为针对这种特定的零支持配置.

blocks.en: All techniques utilize the same support sets and initial prototypes. ProtoT employs residual transfer with parameters set to k = 3 k=3 , β = 1 \beta=1 , automatic temperature control, and the original all-class repulsion. Both ProtoT-VLM and ProtoT-Ont operate without gating. GProtoT incorporates hybrid ranking along with the proposed gating mechanism. Each experiment is conducted alongside SS-Text+ using the identical support set. The ontology is a manually specified ordinal class graph based on the established diabetic-retinopathy severity ordering ( Wilkinson et al., 2003 ) .
blocks.zh: 所有技术都利用了相同的配套装置和初始原型. ProtoT采用剩余转移,参数设置为k=3k=3,β=1\β=1,自动温度控制,原为全级反推. ProtoT-VLM和ProtoT-Ont两种操作均不带吉祥物. GProtoT结合了混合排名以及拟议的配位机制. 每个实验都使用相同的支持集与SS-Text+同时进行. 本体学是根据既定的糖尿病-肾上腺病严重性测序(Wilkinson等人,2003年)手动指定的单体类图。

blocks.en: Because typical instances predominate in the test set, top-1 accuracy is insufficient. In light of the focus on class-aware medical validation ( Maier-Hein and others, 2024 ) , we therefore present average class accuracy (ACA), mean recall over missing classes (MCR), mean recall over supported classes (SCR), and harmonic mean ( H H ).
blocks.zh: 由于在测试集中以典型例子为主,顶级-1的精度不足. 鉴于注重班级认知医学鉴定(Maier-Hein等人,2024年),因此我们提出平均班级准确性(ACA),表示对缺班的召回(MCR),表示对支持班级的召回(SCR),以及口音(HH).

blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that knowledge transfer alone does not guarantee safe transfer. Relative to SS-Text+, both ungated variants yield lower mean performance across all reported metrics. ProtoT-VLM reduces ACA, MCR, SCR, H H , and top-1 accuracy by 2.72, 2.16, 3.10, 2.63, and 2.62 percentage points, respectively and the corresponding reductions for ProtoT-Ont are 2.74, 2.43, 2.94, 2.67, and 2.53 points. Negative transfer is frequent where ProtoT-VLM and ProtoT-Ont reduce MCR relative to the paired baseline in 46% and 48% of seeds, respectively, with reductions exceeding five points in 38% and 34% of seeds. For ProtoT-VLM, the mean MCR change is negative but statistically inconclusive, mean change = − 2.16 =-2.16 points, 95% CI [ − 4.73 , 0.32 ] [-4.73,\,0.32] , Holm-adjusted p = .103 p=.103 , because the interval includes zero. In contrast, ProtoT-Ont produces a statistically significant, although borderline, reduction in MCR, mean change = − 2.43 =-2.43 points, 95% CI [ − 4.68 , − 0.21 ] [-4.68,\,-0.21] , Holm-adjusted p = .049 p=.049 . 1 1 1 Holm correction is applied across the three planned MCR comparisons to control the family-wise error rate arising from multiple paired tests.

blocks.en: Gated-ProtoT reverses the missing-class pattern. It raises MCR to 60.12%, corresponding to a mean paired improvement of 5.23 percentage points, 95% CI [ 3.84 , 6.69 ] [3.84,\,6.69] . It also increases ACA to 56.01%, + 1.37 +1.37 points, 95% CI [ 0.78 , 1.99 ] [0.78,\,1.99] and H H to 54.71%, + 1.83 +1.83 points, 95% CI [ 1.06 , 2.64 ] [1.06,\,2.64] . MCR improves in 36 of the 50 seeds and remains unchanged in 13, leaving only one seed with negative transfer, NTR = 2 % =2\% . These gains are accompanied by modest reductions of 1.20 points in SCR, 95% CI [ − 1.52 , − 0.88 ] [-1.52,\,-0.88] and 0.45 points in top-1 accuracy, 95% CI [ − 0.71 , − 0.19 ] [-0.71,\,-0.19] . Thus, the combined hybrid-ranking and evidence-gating variant substantially improves recognition of zero-support classes.

MCR在50个种子中提高36个,13个种子不变,只留下一个种子负转录,NTR=2%=2\%. 在取得这些成绩的同时,SRC中略微降低了1.20分,CI[−1.52,−0.88][1.52,\,-0.88]和0.45分最高精确度,CI[−0.71,−0.19][-0.71,\,-0.19]。 因此,混合等级和以证据衡量的综合变式大大提高了对零支助类的承认。

blocks.en: Moderate DR is the highest-weighted source for both missing classes across all 50 seeds. The mean gate is 0.582 ± 0.010 0.582\pm 0.010 for severe DR and 0.214 ± 0.003 0.214\pm 0.003 for proliferative DR. The weaker proliferative update reflects its larger nearest-supported ontology distance of two and lower VLM relevance of 0.102 0.102 , compared with distance one and relevance 0.381 0.381 for severe DR. Nevertheless, gate magnitude controls the strength of the prototype update rather than directly determining final recall, which also depends on the baseline prototype, class separability, and resulting decision boundaries. Under Gated-ProtoT, per-class recall is 46.53% for severe DR and 73.71% for proliferative DR, compared with 37.47% and 68.00% under ProtoT-VLM and 36.93% and 68.00% under ProtoT-Ont.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced knowledge-guided prototype transfer under a realistic one-shot protocol in which prevalence-weighted support allocation leaves the classes with no samples entirely unsupported. Knowledge proximity alone did not ensure safe transfer: both VLM and ontology ungated variants lowered every mean performance metric and produced negative transfer in 46 to 48% of the support-sampling seeds. Evidence gating substantially reduced this failure. Gated-ProtoT improved mean missing-class recall by 5.23 percentage points and ACA by 1.37 points, while reducing negative transfer to one of 50 seeds. These improvements were accompanied by modest observed reductions of 1.20 points in supported-class recall and 0.45 points in top-1 accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们根据现实的一弹一弹协议引入了以知识为指南的原型转让,在这种协议中,普遍加权支助分配使各阶层没有任何样本完全得不到支持。 仅靠知识的接近并不能确保安全转移:VLM和肿瘤分类变体都降低了每个平均性能指标,并在46%至48%的支持抽样种子中产生了负转移。 证据大大降低了这一失败。 Gated-ProtoT改进了平均缺级召回5.23个百分点,ACA则提高了1.37个百分点,同时减少了对50个种子之一的负转移. 在作出这些改进的同时,所观察到的支持级召回的1.20分和最高1级准确度的0.45分略有下降。

blocks.en:
The results suggest that calibrating transfer strength can reduce the risks of knowledge-guided transfer. However, because GProtoT combines hybrid ranking with evidence gating, the present comparison does not fully isolate the gate’s
contribution. Skin histology with CONCH ( Lu et al., 2024 ) further shows a 16.43-point MCR gain and a 1.87-point top-1 gain, with no negative MCR changes in 50 paired seeds. These findings extend the evaluation beyond retinal grading, while broader class-rotated validation and isolating the gate’s contribution remain necessary.
blocks.zh:
结果表明,校准转让强度可以减少知识引导转让的风险。 然而,由于GProtoT将混合排名与证据配对相结合,因此目前的比较并不完全孤立大门的
捐款。 与CONCH(Lu et al.,2024)的皮肤神学进一步显示16.43分的MCR增益和1.87分的顶-1增益,50对种子没有负的MCR变化. 这些结论将评价扩大到视网膜分级之外,而更广泛的阶级轮换验证和隔离大门的贡献仍然是必要的。
